***INCLUDE LSENAF01 .

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  Flush_part
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Fordert die Sperren in einer SEQTAB-artigen Tabelle an         *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      --> Seqtab_tab  Tabelle der anzufordernden Sperrpakete
*      --> from        Zeile in Seqtab_tab, von der an die abzuschicken-
*                      den Packete geordnet nach opcode stehen
*      <-- rc          Returncode des Sperrservers
*      <-- user,       ggf. Benutzer und Sperrobjekt mit dessen Sperre
*          obj         angeforderte kollidiert
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM Flush_part TABLES Seqtab_tab STRUCTURE SEQTAB
                USING from LIKE SY-TABIX
                CHANGING rc LIKE SY-SUBRC
                         user LIKE SEQG3-GUNAME
                         obj LIKE SEQG3-GOBJ.

     DATA: to LIKE SY-TABIX,   " bis dahin wurde Seqtab_tab abgearbeitet
           drc LIKE SY-SUBRC,                               " Dummys für
           duser LIKE SEQG3-GUNAME,                         " Aufruf zum
           dobj LIKE SEQG3-GOBJ.                            " Löschen

     FIELD-SYMBOLS <seqtab_wa> LIKE LINE OF SEQTAB.   " Zeiger auf aktu-
                                                      " elles Packet
     rc = 0.
     LOOP AT Seqtab_tab FROM from ASSIGNING <seqtab_wa>.
          to = SY-TABIX - 1.
          PERFORM Flush_package
                  TABLES <seqtab_wa>-SEQTA
                  USING <seqtab_wa>-OPCODE <seqtab_wa>-SCOPE
                        <seqtab_wa>-WAITFLAG <seqtab_wa>-SYNCHRON
                        <seqtab_wa>-ENQOBJ
                  CHANGING rc user obj.
          IF rc <> 0.
             EXIT.
          ENDIF.
     ENDLOOP.
* Wenn die Sperren letztendlich doch nicht durchgekommen sind, müssen
* die schon erfolgreich abgeschickten Packete zurückgenommen werden
     CHECK rc <> 0.
     LOOP AT Seqtab_tab FROM from TO to ASSIGNING <seqtab_wa>
                        WHERE OPCODE = '1'.
          PERFORM Flush_package
                  TABLES <seqtab_wa>-SEQTA
                  USING '2' <seqtab_wa>-SCOPE <seqtab_wa>-WAITFLAG
                        <seqtab_wa>-SYNCHRON <seqtab_wa>-ENQOBJ
                  CHANGING drc duser dobj.
     ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    " Flush_part


*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  Handle_rc
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       behandelt den Returncode des Sperrservers                      *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      --> rc     Returncode des Sperrservers
*      --> user,  ggf. Benutzer und Sperrobjekt mit dessen Sperre
*          obj    angeforderte kollidiert
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM Handle_rc USING VALUE(rc) LIKE SY-SUBRC
                     VALUE(user) LIKE SEQG3-GUNAME
                     VALUE(obj) LIKE SEQG3-GOBJ.

     CASE rc.
          WHEN 0.                                     " alles in Ordnung
          WHEN 1.
               MESSAGE E602 WITH SY-UNAME obj user RAISING FOREIGN_LOCK.
*   Das angeforderte Objekt ist durch eigene Transaktion gesperrt
          WHEN 2.
               MESSAGE E601 WITH user obj RAISING FOREIGN_LOCK.
*   Das angeforderte Objekt ist momentan gesperrt durch User &
          WHEN 16.
               MESSAGE E603 RAISING SYSTEM_FAILURE.
*   Überlauf der Sperrtabelle
          WHEN 64.
               MESSAGE E604 with user obj RAISING FOREIGN_LOCK.
*   Die eigene Sperre ist für das angeforderte Objekt nicht mehr gesetzt
          WHEN OTHERS.
               MESSAGE E600 RAISING SYSTEM_FAILURE.
*   Systemfehler in Sperrverwaltung aufgetreten
     ENDCASE.
ENDFORM.                    " Handle_rc


*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  Flush_list
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Diese Form setzt eine Menge von gleichartigen Sperren an den   *
*       Sperrserver ab.                                                *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      --> Seqta_lis   Tabelle der abzusetzenden Sperren
*      --> opcode      für Sperrserver ( 1 = ENQUEUE, 2 = DEQUEUE )
*      --> scope       für Sperrserver
*      --> waitflag    soll bei Nichtgewähren gewartet werden
*      --> synchron    soll synchron entsperrt werden
*      --> enqobj      Name des Sperrobjekts
*      --> is_homogene ist die Liste als homogen bekannt
*      <-- rc          Returncode des Sperrservers
*      <-- user,       ggf. Benutzer und Sperrobjekt mit dessen Sperre
*          obj         angeforderte kollidiert
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM Flush_list TABLES Seqta_lis STRUCTURE SEQTA
                USING opcode LIKE SEQAREA-OPCODE
                      scope LIKE SEQAREA-SCOPE
                      waitflag LIKE SEQAREA-WAITFLAG
                      synchron LIKE SEQAREA-SYNCHRON
                      enqobj LIKE SEQAREA-ENQOBJ
                      is_homogene LIKE DDREFSTRUC-BOOL
                CHANGING rc LIKE SY-SUBRC
                         user LIKE SEQG3-GUNAME
                         obj LIKE SEQG3-GOBJ.

     DATA: Seqtab_tab LIKE SEQTAB OCCURS 0,
                           " SEQTAB-artige Tabelle, in der die einzelnen
                           " Packete abgespeichert werden, falls nicht
                           " ganze Liste auf einmal abgeschickt wird
           length like SY-TABIX,                   " Größe von Seqta_lis
           at_once LIKE DDREFSTRUC-BOOL,
                                " Ist Liste als homogenes Packet erkannt
           dummy LIKE SY-TABIX.

     DESCRIBE TABLE Seqta_lis LINES length.
     CHECK length > 0.
     IF length =< max_package.
* Wenn höchstens max_package Einträge in Seqta_lis sind, so könnte es
* sich um ein Packet handeln. Wenn opcode = '2' oder wenn is_homogene
* gesetzt ist, dann auf jeden Fall, ansonsten gehen wir nur im Fall, daß
* Sperrmodus X nicht vorkommt von einem Packet aus.
* Wenn Sperrmodus X vorkommt, so könnte es immer noch homogen sein,
* aber wir verzichten auf den Test.
        at_once = 'X'.
        IF is_homogene IS INITIAL AND opcode = '1'.
           READ TABLE Seqta_lis WITH KEY GMODE = 'X'
                TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
           IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
              CLEAR at_once.
           ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
     ENDIF.
     IF at_once IS INITIAL.
        PERFORM Put_in_list TABLES Seqta_lis Seqtab_tab
                            USING 1 opcode scope waitflag synchron
                                  enqobj is_homogene
                            CHANGING dummy.
        PERFORM Flush_part TABLES Seqtab_tab
                           USING 1
                           CHANGING rc user obj.
     ELSE.
          PERFORM Flush_package TABLES Seqta_lis
                                USING opcode scope waitflag synchron
                                      enqobj
                                CHANGING rc user obj.
     ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                    " Flush_list


*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  Flush_package
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Schickt ein Packet (siehe oben) auf einmal an den Sperrserver  *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      --> Seqta_lis   Tabelle der abzusetzenden Sperren
*      --> opcode      für Sperrserver ( 1 = ENQUEUE, 2 = DEQUEUE )
*      --> scope       für Sperrserver
*      --> waitflag    soll bei Nichtgewähren gewartet werden
*      --> synchron    soll synchron entsperrt werden
*      --> enqobj      Name des Sperrobjekts
*      <-- rc          Returncode des Sperrservers
*      <-- user,       ggf. Benutzer und Sperrobjekt mit dessen Sperre
*          obj         angeforderte kollidiert
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM Flush_package TABLES Seqta_lis STRUCTURE SEQTA
                    USING opcode LIKE SEQAREA-OPCODE
                          scope LIKE SEQAREA-SCOPE
                          waitflag LIKE SEQAREA-WAITFLAG
                          synchron LIKE SEQAREA-SYNCHRON
                          enqobj LIKE SEQAREA-ENQOBJ
                    CHANGING rc LIKE SY-SUBRC
                             user LIKE SEQG3-GUNAME
                             obj LIKE SEQG3-GOBJ.

     DATA: times(4),                " wie häufig soll es versucht werden
           delonrej,                           " Wartezeit bei Mißerfolg
           _opcode,                                           " = opcode
           _scope,                                             " = scope
           user_use LIKE user_glob,        " Sperruser, für die Sperren,
           usvb_use LIKE usvb_glob,        " SPACE bedeutet: nimm C-User
           userpar(4),  " SPACE, wenn user_use bzw. usvb_use SPACE ist,
           usvbpar(4).  " sonst Name d. entspr. Parameters von C_ENQUEUE
     STATICS: badi_perf_test type i value 0.

     IF opcode CA '12'.
        _opcode = opcode.
     ELSE.
          rc = 12.
          EXIT.
     ENDIF.
     IF scope CA '123'.
        _scope = scope.
     ELSEIF opcode = '1'.
            _scope = '2'.
         ELSE.
              _scope = '3'.
     ENDIF.
     rc = 0.
     IF waitflag IS INITIAL.
        times = 1.
     ELSE.
          delonrej = 1.
          CALL 'C_ENQ_WILDCARD' ID 'DELAY_MAX' FIELD times.
     ENDIF.
* Nun noch feststellen, ob die zu benutzenden Sperruser explizit gesetzt
* wurden. Falls ja, so muß C_ENQUEUE mit den entsprechenden Parametern
* aufgerufen werden.
     PERFORM Get_enqueue_owner CHANGING user_use usvb_use.
     IF NOT user_use IS INITIAL.
        userpar = 'USER'.
     ENDIF.
     IF NOT usvb_use IS INITIAL.
        usvbpar = 'USVB'.
     ENDIF.
     DO times TIMES.
        CALL 'C_ENQUEUE'
             ID 'OPCODE' FIELD _opcode
             ID 'ENQOBJ' FIELD enqobj
             ID 'GRANULES' FIELD Seqta_lis-*sys*
             ID 'DELAY_ON_REJECT' FIELD delonrej
             ID 'USTP' FIELD _scope
             ID 'COLLISION_UNAME' FIELD user
             ID 'COLLISION_OBJECT' FIELD obj
             ID 'SYNCHRON' FIELD synchron
             ID userpar FIELD user_use
             ID usvbpar FIELD usvb_use.
        IF opcode = '1'.
           rc = SY-SUBRC.
        ENDIF.
        IF rc <> 2.
           EXIT.
        ENDIF.
     ENDDO.

* call BAdis for DD_ENQU_LISTENER
* Note: The BADI call has to be defined in a separate function module
*       because of transport problems (see internal CSN 1917897 2006)
     if ( gv_kayak_active <> space and rc = 0 )
     or ( badi_perf_test <> 0 ).
       perform call_badi
         tables
           seqta_lis
         using
           opcode
           scope
           enqobj
           user_use
           usvb_use
           badi_perf_test.
     endif.

ENDFORM.                    " Flush_package


*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  Send_enqueue
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Schickt eine homogene Menge von Sperren entweder direkt an den *
*       Sperrserver oder in den Container SEQTAB. Im ersten Fall       *
*       wird auch die Ausnahmebehandlung mit durchgeführt              *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      --> Seqta_lis   Tabelle der abzusetzenden Sperren
*      --> opcode      für Sperrserver ( 1 = ENQUEUE, 2 = DEQUEUE )
*      --> scope       für Sperrserver
*      --> waitflag    soll bei Nichtgewähren gewartet werden
*      --> synchron    soll synchron entsperrt werden
*      --> enqobj      Name des Sperrobjekts
*      --> collect     ' ' = sofort absetzen, 'X' = in SEQTAB eintragen
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM Send_enqueue TABLES Seqta_lis STRUCTURE SEQTA
                  USING opcode LIKE SEQAREA-OPCODE
                        scope LIKE SEQAREA-SCOPE
                        waitflag LIKE SEQAREA-WAITFLAG
                        synchron LIKE SEQAREA-SYNCHRON
                        enqobj LIKE SEQAREA-ENQOBJ
                        collect LIKE DDENQ_LIKE-COLLECT.

     DATA: rc LIKE SY-SUBRC,               " Returncode des Sperrservers
           user LIKE SEQG3-GUNAME,      " ggf. User und Sperrobjekt, die
           obj LIKE SEQG3-GOBJ,         " kollidierende Sperre halten
           from LIKE SY-TABIX.  " von hieran Packete in SEQTAB eintragen

     IF collect IS INITIAL.
        PERFORM Flush_list TABLES Seqta_lis
                           USING opcode scope waitflag synchron
                                 enqobj 'X'
                           CHANGING rc user obj.
        PERFORM Handle_rc USING rc user obj.
     ELSE.
          from = flushed_upto + 1.
          PERFORM Put_in_list
                  TABLES Seqta_lis SEQTAB
                  USING from opcode scope waitflag synchron enqobj 'X'
                  CHANGING filled_upto.
     ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                    " Send_enqueue


*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  Find_index
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Findet zu vorgegebenem opcode und scope in einer               *
*       SEQTAB-artigen Tabelle ab einem vorgegebenem Index, ab dem     *
*       diese Tabelle nach OPCODE und SCOPE geordnet ist, den Index    *
*       des ersten passenden noch nicht vollen Packets.                *
*       Falls kein solches Packet gefunden wird, wird der letzte Index *
*       zurückgeliefert, an dem ein solches Packet eingefügt werden    *
*       kann (ohne die Sortierung zu zerstören)                        *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      --> Seqtab_tab  SEQTAB-artige Tabelle
*      --> from        Ab diesem Index ist Seqtab_tab nach OPCODE SCOPE
*                      geordnet, und ab hier ist zu suchen
*      --> filled_upto bis dahin sind alle Packete voll oder geflusht
*      --> opcode,     Parameter einer homogenen Liste von Sperren
*          scope
*      <-- i           Stelle in Seqtab_tab, wo diese einzufügen ist
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM Find_index TABLES Seqtab_tab STRUCTURE SEQTAB
                USING from LIKE SY-TABIX
                      opcode LIKE SEQAREA-OPCODE
                      scope LIKE SEQAREA-SCOPE
                      filled_upto LIKE SY-TABIX
                CHANGING i LIKE SY-TABIX.

     DATA: low LIKE SY-TABIX,           " niedrigst möglicher Wert für i
           high LIKE SY-TABIX,             " höchst möglicher Wert für i
           j LIKE SY-TABIX.            " aktuell zu untersuchende Stelle

     low = from.
     DESCRIBE TABLE Seqtab_tab LINES high.
     ADD 1 TO high.
     IF low =< filled_upto.
* Da das low-te Packet noch nicht geflusht ist, bedeutet das, daß das
* low-te Packet schon voll ist. Im Bereich [low,filled_upto] kann kein
* Packet mehr erweitert werden. Eventuell muß allerdings ein neues
* eingefügt werden, um die Ordnung nach OPCODE SCOPE zu erhalten. Dazu
* gucken wir uns das filled_upto-te Packet an. Wenn es mit der Ordnung
* vertretbar ist, dahinter einzufügen, so können wir low entsprechend
* hochsetzen. Andernfalls können wir high auf filled_upto
* runtersetzen.
        READ TABLE Seqtab_tab INDEX filled_upto
             TRANSPORTING OPCODE SCOPE.
        IF opcode > Seqtab_tab-OPCODE OR
           ( opcode = Seqtab_tab-OPCODE AND scope >= Seqtab_tab-scope ).
           low = filled_upto + 1.
        ELSE.
             high = filled_upto.
        ENDIF.
     ENDIF.
* Nun wird durch binäre Suche dafür gesorgt, daß low solange erhöht
* wird, bis es auf das erste Packet mit vorgegebenem opcode und scope
* zeigt. Falls ein solches nicht existiert, so hat low den Index, an
* dem ein solches packet einzufügen ist.
     WHILE low < high.
           j = ( low + high ) DIV 2.
           READ TABLE Seqtab_tab INDEX j TRANSPORTING OPCODE SCOPE.
           IF Seqtab_tab-OPCODE > opcode OR
              ( Seqtab_tab-OPCODE = opcode AND
                Seqtab_tab-SCOPE >= scope ).
              high = j.
           ELSE.
                low = j + 1.
           ENDIF.
     ENDWHILE.
* Nun überlaufe von low an noch alle vollen Packete mit vorgegebenem
* opcode und scope. Wenn alle Packete ab low voll sind und vorgegebenen
* opcode und scope haben, so muß das nächste Packet ganz ans Ende.
     LOOP AT Seqtab_tab TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS FROM low
          WHERE COUNT <> max_package OR OPCODE <> opcode
                                     OR SCOPE <> scope.
          i = SY-TABIX.
          EXIT.
     ENDLOOP.
     IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
        DESCRIBE TABLE Seqtab_tab LINES i.
        ADD 1 TO i.
     ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                    " Find_index


*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  New_package
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Erzeugt in einer SEQTAB-artigen Tabelle an einer vorgegebenen  *
*       Stelle ein neues Packet, in das soviel wie möglich Sperren aus *
*       aus einer Liste (mindestens eine) eingetragen werden.          *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      --> Seqta_lis   Liste von Sperren
*      --> first       ab hier ist Seqta_lis zu bearbeiten
*      --> n           Größe von Seqta_lis
*      --> opcode,     Attribute der Sperren
*          scope,
*          waitflag,
*          synchron,
*          enqobj
*      --> is_homogene ist die Liste als homogen bekannt
*      --> i           Stelle, für das neue Packet in Seqtab_tab
*      <-- Seqtab_tab  erweitertet um das neue Packet
*      <-- first       um Anzahl der Sperren des neuen Packets erhöht
*      <-> filled_upto bis dahin sind alle Packete voll oder geflusht
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM New_package TABLES Seqtab_tab STRUCTURE SEQTAB
                        Seqta_lis STRUCTURE SEQTA
                 USING opcode LIKE SEQAREA-OPCODE
                       scope LIKE SEQAREA-SCOPE
                       waitflag LIKE SEQAREA-WAITFLAG
                       synchron LIKE SEQAREA-SYNCHRON
                       enqobj LIKE SEQAREA-ENQOBJ
                       is_homogene LIKE DDREFSTRUC-BOOL
                       i LIKE SY-TABIX
                       n LIKE SY-TABIX
                  CHANGING filled_upto LIKE SY-TABIX
                           first LIKE SY-TABIX.

     CHECK first =< n.     " damit keine leeren Packete entstehen können
* Zunächst wird eine Zeile mit vorgegebenem opcode, scope und enqobj
* an die i-te Stelle in Seqtab_tab eingefügt. In diese wird dann mit
* Insert_lines Zeilen aus Seqta_lis übertragen.
     CLEAR Seqtab_tab.
     Seqtab_tab-OPCODE = opcode.
     Seqtab_tab-SCOPE = scope.
     Seqtab_tab-ENQOBJ = enqobj.
     INSERT Seqtab_tab INDEX i.
     IF filled_upto >= i.
        filled_upto = i - 1.
     ENDIF.
     PERFORM Insert_lines
             TABLES Seqtab_tab Seqta_lis
             USING opcode waitflag synchron enqobj is_homogene i n
             CHANGING filled_upto first.
ENDFORM.                    " New_package


*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  Insert_lines
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Fügt soviele Zeilen als möglich einer Sperrliste               *
*       mit konstantem waitflag, synchron und enqobj in ein            *
*       vorgegebenes passendes Packet einer SEQTAB-artigen Tabelle     *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      --> Seqta_lis    Sperrliste
*      --> first        ab diesem Eintrag wird Seqta_lis bearbeitet
*      --> n            Größe von Seqta_lis
*      --> opcode       OPCODE der Sperrliste
*      --> waitflag,    Attribute der Sperren aus Seqta_lis
*          synchron,
*          enqobj
*      --> i            Index des passenden Packets in Seqtab_tab
*      --> is_homogene  ist die Liste bereits als homogen bekannt
*      <-> filled_upto  bis dahin sind alle Packete voll oder geflusht
*      <-- Seqtab_tab   i-tes Packet soweit möglich erweitert
*      <-- first        um die Zahl der übertragenen Sperren erhöht.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM Insert_lines TABLES Seqtab_tab STRUCTURE SEQTAB
                         Seqta_lis STRUCTURE SEQTA
                  USING opcode LIKE SEQAREA-OPCODE
                        waitflag LIKE SEQAREA-WAITFLAG
                        synchron LIKE SEQAREA-SYNCHRON
                        enqobj LIKE SEQAREA-ENQOBJ
                        is_homogene LIKE DDREFSTRUC-BOOL
                        i LIKE SY-TABIX
                        n LIKE SY-TABIX
                  CHANGING filled_upto LIKE SY-TABIX
                           first LIKE SY-TABIX.

     DATA: last LIKE SY-TABIX, " weiter darf in Seqta_lis nicht gegangen
                               "  werden, da Packet sonst zu groß wird
           j LIKE SY-TABIX,       "  von first bis j können die Einträge
                                  " auf einmal übertragen werden
           seqta_wa LIKE SEQTA,         " zum Lesen aus Seqtab_tab-SEQTA
           i_minus_1 LIKE SY-TABIX,                              " i - 1
           move LIKE DDREFSTRUC-BOOL.      " wurde das Packet vergrößert

     FIELD-SYMBOLS <seqtab_wa> LIKE LINE OF SEQTAB.     " i-te Zeile von
                                                        " Seqtab_tab
     READ TABLE Seqtab_tab INDEX i ASSIGNING <seqtab_wa>.
     last = first + max_package - <seqtab_wa>-COUNT - 1.
     IF last > n.
        last = n.
     ENDIF.
     IF <seqtab_wa>-CONTAINS_X IS INITIAL.
* Nur in diesem Fall kann es überhaupt sein, daß mehrere Einträge auf
* einmal übertragen werden können.
        j = last.           " erstmal wollen wir alles auf einmal machen
        IF opcode = '1' AND ( <seqtab_wa>-COUNT <> 0 OR
                              is_homogene IS INITIAL ).
* Wenn opcode = '2' oder wenn eine homogene Liste in ein noch leeres
* Packet eingetragen werden soll, so kann alles auf einmal übertragen
* werden. Sonst nur bis vor dem ersten Eintrag mit Modus 'X'. In diesem
* Fall wird daher geprüft, ob ein Eintrag mit 'X' im zu übertragenden
* Bereich liegt. Wenn ja, wird j entsprechend heruntergesetzt.
           LOOP AT Seqta_lis TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
                FROM first TO last WHERE GMODE = 'X'.
                j = SY-TABIX - 1.
                EXIT.
           ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.
        IF j >= first.
           move = 'X'.
           APPEND LINES OF Seqta_lis FROM first TO j
                  TO <seqtab_wa>-SEQTA.
           first = j + 1.                   " bis j ist alles übertragen
           IF opcode = '1' AND <seqtab_wa>-COUNT = 0
                           AND NOT is_homogene IS INITIAL.
* In diesem Fall haben wir eventuell einen Eintrag mit Modus 'X'
* übertragen. Dann müssen noch die entsprechenden Einstellungen
* vorgenommen werden.
              READ TABLE <seqtab_wa>-SEQTA WITH KEY GMODE = 'X'
                                                TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
              IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
                 <seqtab_wa>-CONTAINS_X = 'X'.
                 SORT <seqtab_wa>-SEQTA BY GNAME.
              ENDIF.
           ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
     ENDIF.
* first kann jetzt nur dann kleiner oder gleich last sein, wenn
* CONTAINS_X bereits gesetzt ist, oder wenn der first-te Eintrag in
* Seqta_lis Modus 'X' hat (und opcode = '1' ist).
* Wenn nämlich CONTAINS_X initial ist, so gilt first = j + 1. j wurde
* aber nur dann vom Wert last verkleinert, wenn an Stelle j + 1 ein
* Modus 'X' stand.
     LOOP AT Seqta_lis FROM first TO last.
          IF <seqtab_wa>-CONTAINS_X IS INITIAL.
             SORT <seqtab_wa>-SEQTA BY GNAME.
          ENDIF.
          READ TABLE <seqtab_wa>-SEQTA INTO seqta_wa
               WITH KEY GNAME = Seqta_lis-GNAME
                    BINARY SEARCH TRANSPORTING GMODE.
          IF SY-SUBRC = 0 AND ( Seqta_lis-GMODE = 'X' OR
                                seqta_wa-GMODE = 'X' ).
             EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          INSERT Seqta_lis INTO <seqtab_wa>-SEQTA INDEX SY-TABIX.
          ADD 1 TO first.
          <seqtab_wa>-CONTAINS_X = 'X'.
          move = 'X'.
     ENDLOOP.
* Wenn tatsächlich was getan wurde, dann müssen noch die anderen
* Attribute angepaßt werden.
     CHECK NOT move IS INITIAL.
     IF NOT waitflag IS INITIAL.
        <seqtab_wa>-WAITFLAG = 'X'.
     ENDIF.
     IF NOT synchron IS INITIAL.
        <seqtab_wa>-SYNCHRON = 'X'.
     ENDIF.
     IF enqobj <> <seqtab_wa>-ENQOBJ.
        <seqtab_wa>-ENQOBJ = standard_enqueue.
     ENDIF.
     DESCRIBE TABLE <seqtab_wa>-SEQTA LINES <seqtab_wa>-COUNT.
     IF <seqtab_wa>-COUNT = max_package.
        i_minus_1 = i - 1.
        IF filled_upto = i_minus_1.
           LOOP AT Seqtab_tab TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS FROM i
                WHERE COUNT < max_package.
                filled_upto = SY-TABIX - 1.
                EXIT.
           ENDLOOP.
           IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
              DESCRIBE TABLE Seqtab_tab LINES filled_upto.
           ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
     ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                    " Insert_lines


*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  Put_in_list
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Trägt Sperren aus einer Liste in eine SEQTAB-artige Tabelle    *
*       ein.                                                           *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      --> Seqta_lis   Liste der einzutragenden Sperren
*      --> opcode,     diese Daten sind für alle Sperren gleich
*          scope,
*          waitflag,
*          synchron,
*          enqobj
*      --> from        ab dieser Stelle in Seqtab_tab soll der Eintrag
*                      erfolgen. Seqtab_tab ist ab hier nach OPCODE
*                      SCOPE geordnet
*      --> is_homogene ist die Liste bereits als homogen bekannt
*      <-> filled_upto bis dahin sind alle Packete voll oder geflusht
*      <-- Seqtab_tab  um die angegebenen Sperren erweitert
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM Put_in_list TABLES Seqta_lis STRUCTURE SEQTA
                        Seqtab_tab STRUCTURE SEQTAB
                 USING from LIKE SY-TABIX
                       opcode LIKE SEQAREA-OPCODE
                       scope LIKE SEQAREA-SCOPE
                       waitflag LIKE SEQAREA-WAITFLAG
                       synchron LIKE SEQAREA-SYNCHRON
                       enqobj LIKE SEQAREA-ENQOBJ
                       is_homogene LIKE DDREFSTRUC-BOOL
                 CHANGING filled_upto LIKE SY-TABIX.

     DATA: i LIKE SY-TABIX,    " Stelle in Seqtab_tab, wo eingefügt wird
           first LIKE SY-TABIX VALUE 1,
           n LIKE SY-TABIX.

     DESCRIBE TABLE Seqta_lis LINES n.
     PERFORM Find_index TABLES Seqtab_tab
                        USING from opcode scope filled_upto
                        CHANGING i.
     WHILE first =< n.
           READ TABLE Seqtab_tab INDEX i TRANSPORTING OPCODE SCOPE.
           IF SY-SUBRC = 0 AND Seqtab_tab-OPCODE = opcode
                           AND Seqtab_tab-SCOPE = scope.
              PERFORM Insert_lines TABLES Seqtab_tab Seqta_lis
                                   USING opcode waitflag synchron enqobj
                                         is_homogene i n
                                   CHANGING filled_upto first.
           ELSE.
                PERFORM New_package TABLES Seqtab_tab Seqta_lis
                                    USING opcode scope waitflag synchron
                                          enqobj is_homogene i n
                                    CHANGING filled_upto first.
           ENDIF.
           ADD 1 TO i.
     ENDWHILE.
ENDFORM.                    " Put_in_list


*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  Get_enqueue_owner
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Bestimmt die aktuell gültigen Enqueue-Owner. Dabei wird die    *
*       Information, daß ein Owner gleich dem Owner der C-Schicht ist, *
*       dadurch dargestellt, daß der entsprechende Owner SPACE ist     *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  <--  user      Enqueue-Owner der Dialogtransaktion
*  <--  usvb      Enqueue-Owner der Verbuchungstransaktion
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM Get_enqueue_owner CHANGING user LIKE user_glob
                                usvb LIKE usvb_glob.

     DATA: user_now LIKE user_glob,                           " aktuelle
           usvb_now LIKE usvb_glob.                           " C-owner

     IF NOT ( user_glob IS INITIAL AND usvb_glob IS INITIAL ).
        PERFORM Get_C_owner CHANGING user_now usvb_now.
        IF user_now <> user_overwritten OR user_now = user_glob.
           CLEAR user_glob.
        ENDIF.
        IF usvb_now <> usvb_overwritten OR usvb_now = usvb_glob.
           CLEAR usvb_glob.
        ENDIF.
     ENDIF.
     user = user_glob.
     usvb = usvb_glob.
ENDFORM.                    " Get_enqueue_owner


*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  Get_C_owner
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Bestimmt die aktuellen C-Sperrowner                            *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      <-- user_now   C-Sperrowner der Dialogtransaktion
*      <-- usvb_now   C-Sperrowner der Verbuchungstransaktion
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM Get_C_owner CHANGING user_now LIKE user_glob
                          usvb_now LIKE usvb_glob.

     CALL 'C_ENQUEUE'
          ID 'OPCODE' FIELD '7'
          ID 'ENQKEY' FIELD user_now
          ID 'ENQKVB' FIELD usvb_now.
ENDFORM.                    " Get_C_owner

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  call_badi
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Call BAdis for DD_ENQU_LISTENER
*Note: The BADI call has to be defined in a separate funtion module
*       because of transport problems (see internal CSN 1917897 2006)
*
************************************************************************
* testing performance impact of BADI calls for tracking lock operations
* in the KAYAK project.
* The times are written into local file BADI_PERF_TEST
*
*time measurement is activated by setting value of variable
*"badi_perf_test"
* to a value different from 0.
*
* Take times for
* - total BADI processing
*- select single badi_name from badi_main (part of total BADI
*processing)
* - CALL FUNCTION 'BADI_...'  (part of total BADI processing)
*
************************************************************************
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
form call_badi
    TABLES
      Seqta_lis STRUCTURE SEQTA
    using
      opcode LIKE SEQAREA-OPCODE
      scope LIKE SEQAREA-SCOPE
      enqobj LIKE SEQAREA-ENQOBJ
      user_use LIKE user_glob
      usvb_use LIKE usvb_glob
      badi_perf_test type i.

     DATA: lv_badi_name type badi_main-badi_name.
     DATA: badi_t1 type i, badi_t1_1 type i, badi_t1_2 type i.
     DATA: badi_t2 type i, badi_t2_1 type i, badi_t2_2 type i.
     DATA: badi_t3 type i, badi_t3_1 type i, badi_t3_2 type i.
     DATA: badi_perf_line(80).
     DATA: nr_t(9).
     STATICS: rc_badi_main type sysubrc value 99.

* get run time
      if badi_perf_test <> 0.
         get run time field badi_t1_1.
         get run time field badi_t2_1.
         get run time field badi_t3_1.
         get run time field badi_t1_2.
         get run time field badi_t2_2.
         get run time field badi_t3_2.
         get run time field badi_t1_1.
       endif.

* check whether BADI exists
       if rc_badi_main = 99.

         if badi_perf_test <> 0. get run time field badi_t2_1. endif.

         select single badi_name from badi_main into lv_badi_name
           where badi_name = 'DD_ENQU_LISTENER'.
*        select count(*) from badi_main up to 1 rows
*          where badi_name = 'DD_ENQU_LISTENER'.
         rc_badi_main = sy-subrc.

         if badi_perf_test <> 0. get run time field badi_t2_2. endif.
       endif.

* call BADI
       if rc_badi_main = 0.

         if badi_perf_test <> 0. get run time field badi_t3_1. endif.

         call function 'CALL_BADI_DD_ENQU_LISTENER'
           exporting
             i_opcode   = opcode
             i_scope    = scope
             i_enqobj   = enqobj
             i_gusr     = user_use
             i_gusrvb   = usvb_use
             t_enqueues = seqta_lis[].

         if badi_perf_test <> 0. get run time field badi_t3_2. endif.
       endif.

* get run time
       if badi_perf_test <> 0.

         get run time field badi_t1_2.

         badi_t1 = badi_t1_2 - badi_t1_1.
         badi_t2 = badi_t2_2 - badi_t2_1.
         badi_t3 = badi_t3_2 - badi_t3_1.

         badi_perf_line =
         'Total/us: &1  Select/us: &2  Call_BADI/us: &3'. "#EC NOTEXT

         nr_t = badi_t1. replace '&1' in badi_perf_line with nr_t.
         nr_t = badi_t2. replace '&2' in badi_perf_line with nr_t.
         nr_t = badi_t3. replace '&3' in badi_perf_line with nr_t.

         open dataset 'BADI_PERF_TEST' for appending in text mode
         encoding default.
         transfer badi_perf_line to 'BADI_PERF_TEST'.
         close dataset 'BADI_PERF_TEST'.

       endif.

endform.                    " call_badi

FUNCTION-POOL SENA MESSAGE-ID MC.

CONSTANTS: max_package TYPE I VALUE 40, " maximale Zahl von Sperren, die
                                        " auf einmal abgesetzt werden
           keep_flushed LIKE DDREFSTRUC-BOOL VALUE ' ',
                    " sollen bereits abgeschickte Sperren gemerkt werden
           standard_enqueue LIKE SEQAREA-ENQOBJ VALUE 'ENQARRAY',
                      " wenn ein Paket Sperren mehrerer Sperrobjekte
                      " enthält, wird das Paket diesem Namen zugeordnet
           c_memory_id_kayak(19) TYPE C VALUE '%_KYK_HOOK_SZN_BADI'.
                      " memory id fuer Aufrufe aus KAYAK

* Die Tabelle SEQTAB ist der Container, in dem die Sperren gehalten
* werden, die dann per Flush an den Sperrserver abgesetzt werden.
* Dabei werden die Sperren in einzelnen Paketen gehalten. Jede Zeile
* von SEQTAB entspricht dabei einem Paket.
* Ein Paket ist eine homogene Liste von Sperren, das höchstens
* max_package Einzelsperren enthält.
* Homogen bedeutet dabei: Alle Sperren haben denselben OPCODE
* ( 1 = Sperre anfordern, 2 = Sperre freigeben ) und denselben SCOPE.
* Im Fall OPCODE = 1 beinhaltet homogen außerdem noch die Forderung,
* daß, wenn in der Liste zwei Sperren auf dieselbe Tabelle auftauchen,
* keine von diesen den Sperrmodus 'X' hat.
* Die Einzelsperren eines Pakets werden in der Komponente SEQTA
* gehalten. Um obige Zusatzbedingung besser zu gewährleisten, wird
* daher im Falle OPCODE = 1 im Flag CONTAINS_X gemerkt, ob bereits eine
* Sperre mit Modus 'X' enthalten ist. Sobald dieses Flag gesetzt ist,
* werden die Einzelsperren nach GNAME sortiert gehalten.
* Um die Größe der Pakete besser kontrollieren zu können, enthält
* die Komponente COUNT immer die Anzahl der Einzelsperren des Pakets.
* Falls nur eine der Einzelsperren des Pakets das waitflag bzw. das
* synchron gesetzt hat, so werden diese Flags jeweils für das ganze
* Paket gesetzt. Die Informationen werden in den jeweiligen Komponenten
* gehalten.
* Falls alle Sperren des Pakets vom selben Sperrobjekt stammen, so
* wird der name dieses Sperrobjekts in ENQOBJ gehalten. Ansonsten hat
* ENQOBJ den Wert standard_enqueue.
* Die Pakete in SEQTAB bis zum Index flushed_upto gehören immer zu
* bereits erfolgreich geflushten Sperren. Dabei bestimmt die Konstante
* keep_flushed, ob diese Sperren überhaupt gemerkt werden sollen, oder
* ob sie nicht gleich aus dem Container entfernt werden sollen.
* Im Bereich hinter flushed_upto werden die Pakete nach OPCODE SCOPE
* geordnet gehalten.
* Die Pakete bis einschließlich filled_upto sind alle schon geflusht
* oder haben die maximale Zahl bereits erreicht. Im Normalfall wird
* daher versucht, neue Pakete hinter diese Stelle einzuhängen. Nur wenn
* dadurch die genannte Sortierung nach OPCODE SCOPE zerstört würde,
* werden Pakete im Bereich von flushed_upto + 1 bis filled_upto
* eingefügt.

DATA: BEGIN OF SEQTAB OCCURS 0,
            OPCODE LIKE SEQAREA-OPCODE,
            SCOPE LIKE SEQAREA-SCOPE,
            WAITFLAG LIKE SEQAREA-WAITFLAG,
            SYNCHRON LIKE SEQAREA-SYNCHRON,
            ENQOBJ LIKE SEQAREA-ENQOBJ,
            COUNT LIKE max_package,
            CONTAINS_X LIKE DDREFSTRUC-BOOL,
            SEQTA LIKE SEQTA OCCURS max_package,
      END OF SEQTAB.

DATA flushed_upto LIKE SY-TABIX. " bis hierhin gehören die Einträge in
                                 " SEQTAB zu bereits geflushten Paketen

DATA filled_upto LIKE SY-TABIX.      " bis hierhin sind alle Einträge in
                                     " SEQTAB voll oder schon geflusht

DATA: user_glob LIKE SEQG3-GUSR,                    " für das Setzen des
      usvb_glob LIKE SEQG3-GUSRVB,                  " Enqueue-Owners
      user_overwritten LIKE SEQG3-GUSR,         " ggf. die durchs Setzen
      usvb_overwritten LIKE SEQG3-GUSRVB.       " überschriebenen Owner

* Die folgende Variable kann für Debug-Zwecke verwendet werden. Indem
* man sie im Debugger umschießt, kann man bei folgenden Aufrufen dieser
* Funktionsgruppe feststellen, ob man sich noch im selben internen
* Modus befindet.
DATA $dbg VALUE 'A'.

                                 " dem Memory

FORM table_db_upd.
  DATA: modified_entries TYPE i, prt_frky_entries TYPE i, rc TYPE i,
        h_ix TYPE i,
        primtab_mod TYPE REF TO data,
        primtab_mod_wa TYPE REF TO data,
        texttab_mod TYPE REF TO data,
        w_texttab_mod TYPE REF TO data,
        e071_loctab TYPE vim_ko200_tab_type.   "#EC NEEDED
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <mod_elem_tab> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                 <h_keyx> TYPE x,                           "#EC NEEDED
                 <mod_elem_wa> TYPE ANY,
                 <texttab> TYPE STANDARD TABLE, <w_texttab> TYPE ANY,
                 <textline_x> TYPE x.

* first of all: delete requests
  CREATE DATA primtab_mod TYPE TABLE OF (x_header-maintview).
  CREATE DATA primtab_mod_wa TYPE (x_header-maintview).
  ASSIGN: primtab_mod->* TO <mod_elem_tab>,
          primtab_mod_wa->* TO <mod_elem_wa>.
  LOOP AT total.
    CHECK ( <action> EQ geloescht OR <action> EQ update_geloescht OR
            <action> EQ neuer_geloescht ).
    IF <action> EQ neuer_geloescht.
      IF status-delete EQ geloescht.
        READ TABLE extract WITH KEY <vim_xtotal_key>.       "#EC WARNOK
        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
          DELETE extract INDEX sy-tabix.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      DELETE total.
    ELSE.
      APPEND <vim_total_struc> TO <mod_elem_tab>.
      ADD 1 TO modified_entries.
      IF x_header-texttbexst EQ space. "no texttab
        IF status-delete EQ geloescht.
          READ TABLE extract WITH KEY <vim_xtotal_key>.     "#EC WARNOK
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
            DELETE extract INDEX sy-tabix.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
        DELETE total.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF modified_entries NE 0.
    DELETE (x_header-maintview) FROM TABLE <mod_elem_tab>.
  ENDIF.
  IF x_header-texttbexst NE space.
    CLEAR modified_entries.
    CREATE DATA texttab_mod TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (x_header-texttab).
    CREATE DATA w_texttab_mod TYPE (x_header-texttab).
    ASSIGN: texttab_mod->* TO <texttab>,
            w_texttab_mod->* TO <w_texttab>,
            <w_texttab> TO <textline_x> CASTING.
* delete texts for all deleted entities
    LOOP AT <mod_elem_tab> INTO <table1_wa>.
      READ TABLE total WITH KEY <f1_wax> BINARY SEARCH.     "#EC WARNOK
      h_ix = sy-tabix.
      IF x_header-ptfrkyexst NE space.
* partial foreign key relation:
* Are there still any primary table entries?
        PERFORM create_wheretab_new USING x_namtab[]
                                          <vim_total_struc>
                                          <vim_tot_txt_struc>
                                          x_header-maintview
                                          'X' rc.
        IF rc NE 0.                    "something seems to be wrong
          prt_frky_entries = 1.        "don't delete
        ELSE.
          SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (x_header-maintview) UP TO 1 ROWS
                          WHERE (vim_wheretab).
          prt_frky_entries = sy-dbcnt.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        CLEAR prt_frky_entries.
      ENDIF.
      IF prt_frky_entries EQ 0.
* No, there aren't.
*        MODIFY mod_elem_tab FROM <total_text>.
        MOVE <vim_xtotal_text> TO <textline_x>.
        APPEND <w_texttab> TO <texttab>.
        ADD 1 TO modified_entries.
      ENDIF.
      IF status-delete EQ geloescht.
        READ TABLE extract WITH KEY <vim_xtotal_key>        "#EC WARNOK
         TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
          DELETE extract INDEX sy-tabix.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      DELETE total INDEX h_ix.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF modified_entries NE 0.
* delete text entries in all languages
      DO modified_entries TIMES.
*        READ TABLE mod_elem_tab INDEX 1.
*        DELETE mod_elem_tab INDEX 1.
*        READ TABLE <texttab> INTO <w_texttab> INDEX 1.
        READ TABLE <texttab> INTO <vim_tot_txt_struc> INDEX 1."IG 862951
        DELETE <texttab> INDEX 1.                           "IG 862951
*        PERFORM create_wheretab TABLES x_namtab
*                                USING mod_elem_tab
*                                      x_header-texttab space rc.

        PERFORM create_wheretab_new USING x_namtab[]
                                          <vim_total_struc>
                                          <vim_tot_txt_struc>
                                          x_header-texttab
                                          space
                                          rc.
        SELECT * FROM (x_header-texttab) APPENDING TABLE <texttab>
                                         WHERE (vim_wheretab).
      ENDDO.
*      DELETE (x_header-texttab) FROM TABLE mod_elem_tab.
      DELETE (x_header-texttab) FROM TABLE <texttab>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
* now update requests
  REFRESH: <mod_elem_tab>.
  CLEAR modified_entries.
  LOOP AT total.
    CHECK <action> EQ aendern.
*    MOVE: total TO <table1>,
*          <table1> TO mod_elem_tab.
*    APPEND mod_elem_tab.
    APPEND <vim_total_struc> TO <mod_elem_tab>.
    ADD 1 TO modified_entries.
    IF x_header-texttbexst EQ space OR
       <action_text> EQ original.
      READ TABLE extract WITH KEY <vim_xtotal_key>.         "#EC WARNOK
      <action> = original.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <xact> = original.
        MODIFY extract INDEX sy-tabix.
      ENDIF.
      MODIFY total.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF modified_entries NE 0.
*------------------*--------------------------------------------
* Changes done on 07.08/2009 to handle Checkman errors. DUTTAN.
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* Start - Handling exceptions for Unique Indexes.
*    TRY.
        UPDATE (x_header-maintview) FROM TABLE <mod_elem_tab>.
*      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db.
*        MESSAGE i862(sv).
*    ENDTRY.
* End - handling.
*---------------------------------------------------------------
* End of  Change. 07/08/2009 DUTTAN.
*---------------------------------------------------------------
  ENDIF.
  IF x_header-texttbexst NE space.
    REFRESH <texttab>.
    CLEAR modified_entries.
    LOOP AT total.
      CHECK <action_text> EQ aendern.
*      MOVE: <total_text> TO mod_elem_tab.
*      APPEND mod_elem_tab.
      MOVE <vim_xtotal_text> TO <textline_x>.
      APPEND <w_texttab> TO <texttab>.
      ADD 1 TO modified_entries.
      READ TABLE extract WITH KEY <vim_xtotal_key>.         "#EC WARNOK
      IF <action> EQ aendern.
        <action> = original. <xact> = original.
      ENDIF.
      <action_text> = original. <xact_text> = original.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        MODIFY extract INDEX sy-tabix.
      ENDIF.
      MODIFY total.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF modified_entries NE 0.
*      UPDATE (x_header-texttab) FROM TABLE mod_elem_tab.
      UPDATE (x_header-texttab) FROM TABLE <texttab>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
* last not least: insert requests
  REFRESH: <mod_elem_tab>. CLEAR modified_entries.
  LOOP AT total.
    CHECK <action> EQ neuer_eintrag.
*    MOVE: total TO <table1>,
*          <table1> TO mod_elem_tab.
*    APPEND mod_elem_tab.
    APPEND <vim_total_struc> TO <mod_elem_tab>.
    ADD 1 TO modified_entries.
    IF x_header-texttbexst EQ space OR
       <action_text> EQ original.
      READ TABLE extract WITH KEY <vim_xtotal_key>.         "#EC WARNOK
      <action> = original.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <xact> = original.
        MODIFY extract INDEX sy-tabix.
      ENDIF.
      MODIFY total.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF modified_entries NE 0.
*------------------*--------------------------------------------
* Changes done on 07.08/2009 to handle Checkman errors. DUTTAN.
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* Start - Handling exceptions for Unique Indexes.
*    TRY.
        INSERT (x_header-maintview) FROM TABLE <mod_elem_tab>.
*      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db.
*        MESSAGE i862(sv).
*    ENDTRY.
* End - Handling.
*---------------------------------------------------------------
* End of  Change. 07/08/2009 DUTTAN.
*---------------------------------------------------------------
  ENDIF.
  IF x_header-texttbexst NE space.
    REFRESH <texttab>.
    CLEAR modified_entries.
    LOOP AT total.
      CHECK <action_text> EQ neuer_eintrag.
*      MOVE: <total_text> TO mod_elem_tab.
*      APPEND mod_elem_tab.
      MOVE <vim_xtotal_text> TO <textline_x>.
      APPEND <w_texttab> TO <texttab>.
      ADD 1 TO modified_entries.
      READ TABLE extract WITH KEY <vim_xtotal_key>.         "#EC WARNOK
      IF <action> EQ neuer_eintrag.
        <action> = original. <xact> = original.
      ENDIF.
      <action_text> = original. <xact_text> = original.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        MODIFY extract INDEX sy-tabix.
      ENDIF.
      MODIFY total.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF modified_entries NE 0.

*                                ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
      INSERT (x_header-texttab) FROM TABLE <texttab>
                                ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
      IF sy-subrc NE 0. "duplicate keys -> process additional update
*        UPDATE (x_header-texttab) FROM TABLE mod_elem_tab.
        UPDATE (x_header-texttab) FROM TABLE <texttab>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

*    Call synchronizer

*  APPEND e071 TO e071_loctab.

*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_texttab_key USING enti_wa text_wa.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <enti>, <text>.
  DATA: index TYPE i.
  LOOP AT x_namtab WHERE texttabfld NE space
                     AND keyflag NE space.   "all keyfields of text table
    index = x_namtab-position - x_header-tablen.
    ASSIGN text_wa+index(x_namtab-flength) TO <text>.
    IF x_namtab-primtabkey EQ space.   "language key
      MOVE sy-langu TO <text>.
    ELSE.
      index = x_namtab-primtabkey.
      READ TABLE x_namtab INDEX index.   "corresponding field of entity tb
      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
        ASSIGN enti_wa+x_namtab-position(x_namtab-flength) TO <enti>.
        MOVE <enti> TO <text>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  DATA: index TYPE i.
  LOOP AT x_namtab ASSIGNING <namtab> WHERE texttabfld NE space

    ASSIGN COMPONENT <namtab>-viewfield OF STRUCTURE text_wa
     TO <text>.

      MOVE sy-langu TO <text>.
    ELSE.
      index = <namtab>-primtabkey.
      READ TABLE x_namtab ASSIGNING <namtab2> INDEX index.
* corresponding field of entity tb
      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  TABLEFRAME                                              *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* program for function TABLEFRAME_<area>                              *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM  tableframe TABLES header STRUCTURE vimdesc
                        namtab STRUCTURE vimnamtab
                        dbasellist STRUCTURE vimsellist
                        dplsellist STRUCTURE vimsellist
                        exclcuafunct STRUCTURE vimexclfun
                 USING  corrnumber
                        viewaction
                        viewname.                                        "#EC NEEDED

  DATA: enqueue_processed TYPE c, "flag: view enqueued by VIEWFRAME_..
        table_type(11) TYPE c,         "type of table to use
        table_length TYPE i.           "length of current table

*-<<<-------------------------------------------------------------->>>>*
* first of all: determine well-sized internal tables etc.              *
*-<<<-------------------------------------------------------------->>>>*
  READ TABLE header INDEX 1.
  table_length = header-tablen / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize + 2.
*  tab lg. + action + mark
  IF header-texttbexst NE space.
    table_length = table_length
     + header-texttablen / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize + 1.
* txtb+txtact
  ENDIF.
  IF table_length LE ultra_short_tab.
    MOVE 'ULTRA_SHORT'     TO table_type.
    FREE: extract_vs, total_vs,
          extract_s, total_s,
          extract_m, total_m,
          extract_l, total_l,
          extract_vl, total_vl,
          extract_ul, total_ul.
  ELSEIF table_length LE very_short_tab.
    MOVE 'VERY_SHORT'     TO table_type.
    FREE: extract_us, total_us,
          extract_s, total_s,
          extract_m, total_m,
          extract_l, total_l,
          extract_vl, total_vl,
          extract_ul, total_ul.
  ELSEIF table_length LE short_tab.
    MOVE 'SHORT'     TO table_type.
    FREE: extract_us, total_us,
          extract_vs, total_vs,
          extract_m, total_m,
          extract_l, total_l,
          extract_vl, total_vl,
          extract_ul, total_ul.
  ELSEIF table_length LE middle_tab.
    MOVE 'MIDDLE'    TO table_type.
    FREE: extract_us, total_us,
          extract_vs, total_vs,
          extract_s, total_s,
          extract_l, total_l,
          extract_vl, total_vl,
          extract_ul, total_ul.
  ELSEIF table_length LE long_tab.
    MOVE 'LONG'    TO table_type.
    FREE: extract_us, total_us,
          extract_vs, total_vs,
          extract_s, total_s,
          extract_m, total_m,
          extract_vl, total_vl,
          extract_ul, total_ul.
  ELSEIF table_length LE very_long_tab.
    MOVE 'VERY_LONG'    TO table_type.
    FREE: extract_us, total_us,
          extract_vs, total_vs,
          extract_s, total_s,
          extract_m, total_m,
          extract_l, total_l,
          extract_ul, total_ul.
  ELSEIF table_length LE ultra_long_tab.
    MOVE 'ULTRA_LONG'    TO table_type.
    FREE: extract_us, total_us,
          extract_vs, total_vs,
          extract_s, total_s,
          extract_m, total_m,
          extract_l, total_l,
          extract_vl, total_vl.
  ENDIF.
  maint_mode = viewaction.
  corr_nbr = corrnumber.
*-<<<-------------------------------------------------------------->>>>*
* Entrypoint after changing maintenance mode (show <--> update)        *
*-<<<-------------------------------------------------------------->>>>*
  DO.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Select data from database                                            *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
    PERFORM table_call_function TABLES dbasellist dplsellist
                                header namtab exclcuafunct
                                USING read table_type update_flag.
    CASE sy-subrc.
      WHEN 1.
        RAISE missing_corr_number.
    ENDCASE.
*-<<<-------------------------------------------------------------->>>>*
* Entrypoint after saving data into database                           *
* Entrypoint after refreshing selected entries from database           *
*-<<<-------------------------------------------------------------->>>>*
    DO.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Edit data                                                            *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
      DO.
        PERFORM table_call_function
                             TABLES dbasellist dplsellist
                                    header namtab exclcuafunct
                             USING edit table_type <status>-upd_flag.
        CASE sy-subrc.
          WHEN 1.
            IF maint_mode EQ transportieren AND viewaction EQ aendern.
              MOVE viewaction TO maint_mode.
            ELSE.
              RAISE missing_corr_number.
            ENDIF.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            EXIT.
        ENDCASE.
      ENDDO.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  Handle usercommands...                                              *
*  ...at first handle commands which could cause loss of data          *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
      IF function EQ back.
        function = end.
      ENDIF.
      IF ( function EQ switch_to_show_mode OR
           function EQ get_another_view    OR
           function EQ switch_transp_to_upd_mode OR
           function EQ end ) AND
         <status>-upd_flag NE space.
        PERFORM beenden.
        CASE sy-subrc.
          WHEN 0.
            PERFORM table_call_function
                         TABLES dbasellist dplsellist
                                header namtab exclcuafunct
                         USING save table_type <status>-upd_flag.
            CASE sy-subrc.
              WHEN 0.
                IF <status>-upd_flag EQ space. EXIT. ENDIF.
              WHEN 1.
                RAISE missing_corr_number.
              WHEN 3.
            ENDCASE.
          WHEN 8.
            EXIT.
          WHEN 12.
        ENDCASE.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  ...2nd: transport request                                           *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
      ELSEIF function EQ transport.
        IF <status>-upd_flag NE space.
          PERFORM transportieren.
          CASE sy-subrc.
            WHEN 0.
              PERFORM table_call_function
                              TABLES dbasellist dplsellist
                                     header namtab exclcuafunct
                              USING save table_type <status>-upd_flag.
              CASE sy-subrc.
                WHEN 0.
                  maint_mode = transportieren.
                WHEN 1.
                  RAISE missing_corr_number.
                WHEN 3.
              ENDCASE.
            WHEN 8.
              EXIT.
            WHEN 12.
          ENDCASE.
        ELSE.
          maint_mode = transportieren.
        ENDIF.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  ...now reset or save requests                                       *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
      ELSEIF function EQ reset_list  OR
             function EQ reset_entry OR
             function EQ save.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  Refresh selected entries from database or save data into database   *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
        PERFORM table_call_function
                          TABLES dbasellist dplsellist
                                 header namtab exclcuafunct
                          USING function table_type <status>-upd_flag.
        CASE sy-subrc.
          WHEN 1.
            RAISE missing_corr_number.
          WHEN 3.
        ENDCASE.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  ...now other commands...                                            *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
    CASE function.
      WHEN switch_to_show_mode.
*   change maintenance mode from update to show
        PERFORM enqueue USING 'D' header-frm_af_enq. "dequeue view
        CLEAR enqueue_processed.
        maint_mode = anzeigen.
      WHEN switch_to_update_mode.
*     change maintenance mode from show to update
        PERFORM enqueue USING 'E' header-frm_af_enq.  "enqueue view
        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
          MOVE 'X' TO enqueue_processed.
          maint_mode = aendern.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN switch_transp_to_upd_mode.
*     change maintenance mode from transport to update
        maint_mode = aendern.
      WHEN transport.
*     change maintenance mode from update to transport
        maint_mode = transportieren.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        IF enqueue_processed NE space.
          PERFORM enqueue USING 'D' header-frm_af_enq."dequeue view
        ENDIF.
        PERFORM before_leaving_frame_function
                                      USING header-frm_bf_end.
        EXIT.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDDO.
ENDFORM.                                                    "

*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form TABLEPROC                                                *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* program for function TABLEPROC_<area>                               *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM  tableproc.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Initialization: set field-symbols etc.                               *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
  IF last_view_info NE view_name.
    PERFORM initialisieren.
  ENDIF.
  PERFORM justify_action_mode.
  MOVE: view_action TO maint_mode,
        corr_number TO corr_nbr.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Get data from database                                               *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
  IF fcode EQ read OR fcode EQ read_and_edit.
    PERFORM prepare_read_request.
    IF x_header-frm_rp_get NE space.
      PERFORM (x_header-frm_rp_get) IN PROGRAM (sy-repid).
    ELSE.
      PERFORM table_get_data.
    ENDIF.
    IF fcode EQ read_and_edit. fcode = edit. ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  CASE fcode.
    WHEN  edit.                        " Edit read data
      PERFORM call_dynpro.
      PERFORM check_upd.
*....................................................................*

    WHEN save.                         " Write data into database
      PERFORM prepare_saving.
      IF <status>-upd_flag NE space.
        IF x_header-frm_rp_upd NE space.
          PERFORM (x_header-frm_rp_upd) IN PROGRAM.
        ELSE.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
            PERFORM table_db_upd.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
        PERFORM after_saving.
      ENDIF.
*....................................................................*

    WHEN reset_list.     " Refresh all marked entries of EXTRACT from db
      PERFORM reset_entries USING list_bild.
*....................................................................*

    WHEN reset_entry.               " Refresh single entry from database
      PERFORM reset_entries USING detail_bild.
*.......................................................................
  ENDCASE.
  MOVE: <status>-upd_flag TO update_required,
*  IF vim_called_by_cluster NE 'X'.   " MPRE 1449801
        function TO ucomm.            " PATIDARP 1496366
*  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                               "tableproc

*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      FORM  REPLACE_FORBIDDEN_CHARS                                 *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* replace forbidden characters with internal code into NAME           *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* ---> NAME - name to correct                                         *
* ---> FORBIDDEN_CHARS - chars which must be replaced                 *
* <--- NAME - corrected name                                          *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM  replace_forbidden_chars USING value(forbidden_chars) name.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <code>.
  DATA: suspect_char(1) TYPE c, code(2) TYPE c.

  DO.
    IF name CA forbidden_chars.
      ASSIGN name+sy-fdpos(1)  TO <code>.
      MOVE <code> TO suspect_char.
      ASSIGN <code> TO <code> TYPE 'X'.
      MOVE <code> TO code.
      REPLACE suspect_char WITH code INTO name.
    ELSE.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDDO.
ENDFORM.                               "replace_forbidden_chars

  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <namtab> TYPE vimnamtab.

  REFRESH p_text_keyflds.
  IF texttabname_save = p_texttabname.
    APPEND LINES OF text_keyflds_save TO p_text_keyflds.

    ENDLOOP.
    APPEND LINES OF p_text_keyflds TO text_keyflds_save.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                               " vim_get_text_keyflds

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM VIM_PROCESS_MESSAGE                                      *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* process message depending on dialog mode                            *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* VALUE(PM_ID)          ---> ID of message to send                    *
* VALUE(PM_ONLINE_TYPE) ---> message type used for online mode        *
* VALUE(PM_BATCH_TYPE)  ---> message type used for batch mode         *
* VALUE(PM_NBR)         ---> number of message to send                *
* VALUE(PM_V1)          ---> first mesage variable                    *
* VALUE(PM_V2)          ---> second mesage variable                   *
* VALUE(PM_V3)          ---> third mesage variable                    *
* VALUE(PM_V4)          ---> fourth mesage variable                   *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM VIM_PROCESS_MESSAGE USING VALUE(PM_ID) LIKE SY-MSGID
                           VALUE(PM_ONLINE_TYPE) LIKE SY-MSGTY
                           VALUE(PM_BATCH_TYPE) LIKE SY-MSGTY
                           VALUE(PM_NBR)  LIKE SY-MSGNO
                           VALUE(PM_V1) LIKE SY-MSGV1
                           VALUE(PM_V2) LIKE SY-MSGV2
                           VALUE(PM_V3) LIKE SY-MSGV3
                           VALUE(PM_V4) LIKE SY-MSGV4.

  DATA: I_TYPE LIKE SPROT_U-SEVERITY, I_MSGTY LIKE SY-MSGTY,
        I_MSGNO LIKE SY-MSGNO,
        objtype TYPE ob_typ, objname TYPE ob_object.

  IF VIM_NO_DIALOG NE SPACE.           "no dialog - write protocol
    I_TYPE = I_MSGTY = PM_BATCH_TYPE. I_MSGNO = PM_NBR.
    IF VIM_IMPORT_PROFILE = 'X'.        "Profilimport
      IF vim_called_by_cluster NE 'X'.
         objname = VIM_VIEW_NAME.
        IF x_header-bastab EQ space.
        objtype = 'V'.
      ELSE.
        objtype = 'S'.
      ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        objname = vim_calling_cluster.
        objtype = 'C'.
      ENDIF.
      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PROT_DATA_WRITE'
          EXPORTING
            act_id           = VIM_ACTOPTS-ACT_ID
            bcset_id         = VIM_BCSET_ID
            objectname       = objname
*           tablename        = object
*           tabletype        = tabtype
            tablekey         = VIM_PROFILE_ERRORKEY
            msgid            = PM_ID
            msgty            = I_TYPE
            msgno            = I_MSGNO
            var1             = PM_V1
            var2             = PM_V2
            var3             = PM_V3
            var4             = PM_V4
            objecttype       = objtype.
    ELSE.
      TRANSLATE I_TYPE USING 'I S '.
      CALL FUNCTION 'LCT_MESSAGE'
         EXPORTING
              IV_MSGID  = PM_ID
              IV_MSGTY  = I_TYPE
              IV_MSGNO  = I_MSGNO
              IV_MSGV1  = PM_V1
              IV_MSGV2  = PM_V2
              IV_MSGV3  = PM_V3
              IV_MSGV4  = PM_V4
              IV_DIALOG = SPACE.
    ENDIF.
    VIM_LAST_LOGGED_MESSAGE-ID = PM_ID.
    VIM_LAST_LOGGED_MESSAGE-TYPE = I_MSGTY.
    VIM_LAST_LOGGED_MESSAGE-NBR = PM_NBR.
    VIM_LAST_LOGGED_MESSAGE-V1 = PM_V1.
    VIM_LAST_LOGGED_MESSAGE-V2 = PM_V2.
    VIM_LAST_LOGGED_MESSAGE-V3 = PM_V3.
    VIM_LAST_LOGGED_MESSAGE-V4 = PM_V4.
    IF VIM_IMPORT_NO_MESSAGE EQ SPACE.
      MESSAGE ID PM_ID TYPE I_MSGTY NUMBER PM_NBR "to raise exception
                WITH PM_V1 PM_V2 PM_V3 PM_V4.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.                                "with dialog - use pm_online_type
    I_MSGTY = PM_ONLINE_TYPE.
    MESSAGE ID PM_ID TYPE I_MSGTY NUMBER PM_NBR
              WITH PM_V1 PM_V2 PM_V3 PM_V4.
  ENDIF.                               "vim_no_dialog eq space
ENDFORM.                               "vim_process_message

*

        var4             = pm_v4

  IF vim_import_no_message EQ space.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*   INCLUDE LSVIMFL1
**----------------------------------------------------------------------
*
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM VIM_GET_TEXTTAB_DATA                                     *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Texteinträge von der DB nachlesen für angeg. Sprachen               *
* UFProbl251070/1998: Falls X_NAMTAB-Reihenfolge nicht mit
*                     DBA-SELLIST-Reihenfolge übereinstimmt, werden
*                     ANDs oder ORs verschluckt.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  --> LANGUS         ausgewählte Sprachen
* <--> TEXTTAB
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM vim_get_texttab_data TABLES langus STRUCTURE h_t002
                          CHANGING texttab TYPE table.
*                                  Type VIM_LINE_US/../VIM_LINE_UL
  DATA: tgd_sellist LIKE vimsellist OCCURS 10, tgd_sel LIKE vimsellist,
        wheretab_line LIKE vimwheretb,
        spras_value(3) TYPE c,
*        curr_spras(1) TYPE c,
        keylen TYPE i,
        l TYPE i, sellist_l TYPE i, tbx TYPE i,
        and_or_str(6) TYPE c, left_par(1) TYPE c,
        tmp_texttab TYPE REF TO data,
        tmp_texttab_wa TYPE REF TO data,
*        tmp_texttab TYPE vim_tab_ul WITH HEADER LINE,
        texttab_tabix LIKE sy-tabix,
        align1 type f,                                     "#EC NEEDED
        texttab_wa TYPE vim_line_ul,
        align2 type f,                                   "#EC NEEDED
        view_wa TYPE tabl8000, map_error TYPE xfeld.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <tmp_texttab> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                 <tmp_texttab_wa> TYPE ANY, <tmp_texttab_wax> TYPE x,
                 <view_key> TYPE x, <next_spras> TYPE spras,
                 <curr_spras> TYPE spras,
                 <h_texttab> TYPE x, <h_texttab_wa> TYPE x,
                 <viewkey_in_texttab> TYPE x, <texttab_struc> TYPE ANY.

  CREATE DATA: tmp_texttab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (x_header-texttab),
               tmp_texttab_wa TYPE (x_header-texttab).
  ASSIGN: tmp_texttab->* TO <tmp_texttab>,
          tmp_texttab_wa->* TO <tmp_texttab_wa>,
          <tmp_texttab_wa> TO <tmp_texttab_wax> CASTING.

  IF x_header-selection NE space.
    LOOP AT dba_sellist INTO tgd_sel       "UFProbl251070/1998
     WHERE value <> space OR initial = 'X'.
      LOOP AT x_namtab WHERE viewfield EQ tgd_sel-viewfield
                       AND keyflag NE space AND txttabfldn NE space.
        tgd_sel-viewfield = x_namtab-txttabfldn.
        tgd_sel-tabix     = sy-tabix.
        APPEND tgd_sel TO tgd_sellist.
        EXIT.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.                                "UFProbl251070/1998
  ENDIF.                               "X_HEADER-SELECTION

  DESCRIBE TABLE tgd_sellist LINES sellist_l.
  IF sellist_l > 0.
    READ TABLE tgd_sellist INDEX sellist_l INTO tgd_sel.
    IF tgd_sel-and_or NE space.
      CLEAR tgd_sel-and_or.
      MODIFY tgd_sellist INDEX sellist_l FROM tgd_sel.
    ENDIF.
    CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_FILL_WHERETAB'
         EXPORTING
              tablename               = x_header-texttab
              only_cnds_for_keyflds   = 'X'
              is_texttable            = 'X'
         TABLES
              sellist                 = tgd_sellist
              wheretab                = vim_wheretab
              x_namtab                = x_namtab
         EXCEPTIONS
              no_conditions_for_table = 01.
    IF sy-subrc = 1. sellist_l = 0. ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    REFRESH vim_wheretab.
  ENDIF.

* VIM_WHERETAB um Bedingungen für ausgew. Sprachen ergänzen
  DESCRIBE TABLE langus LINES l.
  IF l > 1.
    and_or_str = 'OR'.
    IF sellist_l > 0.
      left_par = '('.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
  tbx = 1.
  spras_value = ''' '''.
  LOOP AT langus.
    spras_value+1(1) = langus-spras.
    IF tbx = l.      " letzte Zeile für Sprachselektion
      IF l > 1 AND sellist_l > 0.
        and_or_str = ' ) AND'.
      ELSEIF l = 1 AND sellist_l > 0.
        and_or_str = ' AND'.
      ELSE.
        CLEAR and_or_str.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
* Start of note 1449599
    IF x_header-sprasfield IS INITIAL.
      SELECT SINGLE fieldname FROM dd03l INTO x_header-sprasfield  "IM 3506611/2010
                              WHERE tabname  EQ x_header-texttab   "PATIDARP
                                AND keyflag  EQ 'X'
                                AND datatype EQ 'LANG'.
*      x_header-sprasfield = 'SPRAS'.
    ENDIF.
* End of note 1449599
   CONCATENATE left_par x_header-sprasfield 'EQ' spras_value and_or_str
                            INTO wheretab_line SEPARATED BY space.
    INSERT wheretab_line INTO vim_wheretab INDEX tbx.
    CLEAR left_par.
    tbx = tbx + 1.
  ENDLOOP.

  SELECT * FROM (x_header-texttab) INTO TABLE <tmp_texttab>
                                      WHERE (vim_wheretab).

* Texttabellen-Einträge sortiert in Texttabelle einfügen
  IF x_header-delmdtflag <> space AND  "zeitabh. & part. Fremdschl.
     x_header-ptfrkyexst  = 'X'.       "      -> zeitunabh. Texttab.
    keylen = x_header-after_keyc
              - vim_datum_length * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.
  ELSE.
    keylen = x_header-after_keyc.
  ENDIF.
  ASSIGN: view_wa(keylen) TO <view_key>,
          texttab_wa TO <h_texttab_wa> CASTING,
          <h_texttab_wa>(keylen) TO <viewkey_in_texttab>,
          <h_texttab_wa>+keylen(x_header-texttablen) TO <h_texttab>,
          <h_texttab> TO <texttab_struc>
           CASTING TYPE (x_header-texttab),
          COMPONENT x_header-sprasfield OF STRUCTURE <texttab_struc>
           TO <next_spras>,
          COMPONENT x_header-sprasfield OF STRUCTURE <tmp_texttab_wa>
           TO <curr_spras>.
  LOOP AT <tmp_texttab> INTO <tmp_texttab_wa>.
    PERFORM map_texttabkey_to_viewkey TABLES x_namtab
                                      USING x_header
                                            <tmp_texttab_wax>
                                            x_header-textkeylen
                                            x_header-genertxtrp
                                      CHANGING <view_key>
                                               map_error.
    CHECK map_error = space.
*    PERFORM vim_fill_view_key USING tmp_texttab
*                           CHANGING <view_key> curr_spras.
    CLEAR texttab_wa.
    READ TABLE texttab WITH KEY <view_key> INTO texttab_wa  "#EC WARNOK
                                                        BINARY SEARCH.
    texttab_tabix = sy-tabix.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND
      <viewkey_in_texttab> = <view_key> AND  "Text ex. in weiteren Spr
      <next_spras> < <curr_spras>. "#EC PORTABLE
      LOOP AT texttab FROM texttab_tabix INTO texttab_wa.
        IF <viewkey_in_texttab> <> <view_key> OR
           <next_spras> >= <curr_spras>. "#EC PORTABLE
          texttab_tabix = sy-tabix.
          EXIT.
* Condition Redundant - Internal Message 0001699060 - ACHACHADI
*        ELSEIF <next_spras> < <curr_spras>.               "#EC BOOL_OK
         ELSE.
          texttab_tabix = sy-tabix + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.   " <next_spras> >= <curr_spras> oder ex. nicht
    IF <next_spras> <> <curr_spras> OR
       <viewkey_in_texttab> <> <view_key>.  "Text ex. nicht in Sprache
      CLEAR texttab_wa.
      <viewkey_in_texttab> = <view_key>.
      <texttab_struc> = <tmp_texttab_wa>.
      INSERT texttab_wa INTO texttab INDEX texttab_tabix.
    ELSE.
      <texttab_struc> = <tmp_texttab_wa>.
      MODIFY texttab FROM texttab_wa INDEX texttab_tabix.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.                             " tmp_texttab
ENDFORM.                               "VIM_GET_TEXTTAB_DATA

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM VIM_READ_TEXTTAB_ENTRY                                   *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* einzelnen Texttabellen-Eintrag für alle bisher bearbeiteten         *
* Sprachen nachlesen
* Aktueller Eintrag steht in Kopfzeile von EXTRACT
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM vim_read_texttab_entry.
  DATA: texttab_wa TYPE vim_line_ul,
        texttab_tabix LIKE sy-tabix,
        keylen TYPE i,
        offset TYPE i,
        modify_texttab(1) TYPE c,
        tmp_texttab TYPE ref to data,
        w_tmp_texttab type ref to data.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <h_texttab_wa> type x,
                 <viewkey_in_texttab> type x,               "#EC FD_ASSGN
                 <texttab_key> type x,
                 <texttab_fields>, <texttab_action> type c,
                 <extract_key> type x,
                 <tmp_texttab> type standard table,
                 <w_tmp_texttab> type any,
                 <w_tmp_texttab_x> type x.

  IF x_header-delmdtflag <> space AND  "zeitabh. & part. Fremdschl.
     x_header-ptfrkyexst  = 'X'.       "      -> zeitunabh. Texttab.
    ASSIGN <vim_ext_mkey_beforex> TO <extract_key>.
*    ASSIGN <vim_ext_mkey_before> TO <extract_key>.
    keylen = x_header-keylen
              - vim_datum_length * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.
  ELSE.
    ASSIGN <vim_xextract_key> TO <extract_key>.
     keylen = x_header-after_keyc.
*    keylen = x_header-keylen.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE <vim_texttab> WITH KEY <extract_key>           "#EC WARNOK
                           BINARY SEARCH TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    texttab_tabix = sy-tabix.
  ELSE.
    EXIT.     "keine Texte zum Key in anderen Sprachen erfaßt
  ENDIF.

  ASSIGN: texttab_wa TO <h_texttab_wa> casting,
          <h_texttab_wa>+keylen(x_header-textkeylen) TO <texttab_key>,
          <h_texttab_wa>+keylen(x_header-texttablen)
           TO <texttab_fields>.
*  ASSIGN texttab_wa(keylen) TO <viewkey_in_texttab>.
*  ASSIGN texttab_wa+keylen(x_header-textkeylen) TO <texttab_key>.
*  ASSIGN texttab_wa+keylen(x_header-texttablen) TO <texttab_fields>.
  offset = ( keylen + x_header-texttablen )
           / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.
*  offset = keylen + x_header-texttablen.
  ASSIGN texttab_wa+offset(1) TO <texttab_action>.

  create data tmp_texttab type standard table of (x_header-texttab).
  create data w_tmp_texttab type (x_header-texttab).
  assign: tmp_texttab->* to <tmp_texttab>,
          w_tmp_texttab->* to <w_tmp_texttab>,
          <w_tmp_texttab> to <w_tmp_texttab_x> casting.
  LOOP AT <vim_texttab> FROM texttab_tabix INTO texttab_wa.
*    IF <viewkey_in_texttab> <> <extract_key>. EXIT. ENDIF. "Commented ACHACHADI 1352850
    IF <texttab_action> = neuer_eintrag.
      DELETE <vim_texttab>.
      modify_texttab = 'X'.
    ELSEIF <texttab_action> <> original.
      refresh <tmp_texttab>.
*      REFRESH tmp_texttab.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DB_SELECT_GENERIC_TABLE'
           EXPORTING
                genkey      = <texttab_key>
                genkey_ln   = x_header-textkeylen
                tablename   = x_header-texttab
           TABLES
                inttab      = <tmp_texttab>
*                inttab      = tmp_texttab
           EXCEPTIONS
                db_error    = 12
                not_found   = 04
                wrong_param = 08.
      IF sy-subrc > 4. RAISE get_table_error. ENDIF.        "#EC FB_RAIS_EX

      READ TABLE <tmp_texttab> into <w_tmp_texttab> INDEX 1.
*      READ TABLE tmp_texttab INDEX 1.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <texttab_fields> = <w_tmp_texttab_x>(x_header-texttablen).
*        <texttab_fields> = tmp_texttab(x_header-texttablen).
        <texttab_action> = original.
        MODIFY <vim_texttab> FROM texttab_wa.
        modify_texttab = 'X'.
      ELSE.                            "NOT_FOUND
        DELETE <vim_texttab>.
        modify_texttab = 'X'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF modify_texttab = 'X'.
    MODIFY vim_texttab_container INDEX vim_texttab_container_index.
    CLEAR sy-subrc.
  ELSE.
    sy-subrc = 4.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                               "VIM_READ_TEXTTAB_ENTRY

*        tmp_texttab TYPE vim_tab_ul WITH HEADER LINE.
